   315→  // =========================================================================
   316→  // PHASE 2: CASCADE - Route to locked model
   317→  // =========================================================================
   318→  const selectedModel = models[LOCKED_MODEL.modelId];
   319→
   320→  if (!selectedModel) {
   321→    // This should never happen if LOCKED_MODEL is valid
   322→    console.error('Locked model not found in models registry:', LOCKED_MODEL.modelId);
   323→    return NextResponse.json({
   324→      error: 'AI service configuration error',
   325→      details: 'No valid model available'
   326→    }, { status: 500 });
   327→  }
   328→
   329→  // =========================================================================
   330→  // PHASE 3: LOCK - Lock all parameters before generation
   331→  // =========================================================================
   332→  // System prompt adapts based on visitor archetype (invisible adaptation)
   333→  const systemPrompt = buildSystemPrompt(context, visitor);
   334→
   335→  const aiMessages = [
   336→    { role: 'system' as const, content: systemPrompt },
   337→    // Include previous conversation for context (limit enforced by LOCKED_PARAMS)
   338→    ...conversationHistory.slice(-LOCKED_PARAMS.historyLimit).map((msg: ConversationMessage) => ({
   339→      role: (msg.type === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant') as 'user' | 'assistant',
   340→      content: msg.text
   341→    })),
   342→    { role: 'user' as const, content: message }
   343→  ];
   344→
   345→  // =========================================================================
   346→  // PHASE 4: EXECUTE - Generate with locked params
   347→  // =========================================================================
   348→  try {
   349→    if (stream) {
   350→      const result = await streamText({
   351→        model: selectedModel,
   352→        messages: aiMessages,
   353→        maxOutputTokens: LOCKED_PARAMS.maxOutputTokens,
   354→        temperature: LOCKED_PARAMS.temperature,
   355→      });
   356→
   357→      return new Response(result.textStream, {
   358→        headers: {
   359→          'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
   360→          'Transfer-Encoding': 'chunked',
   361→          'X-Model-Used': LOCKED_MODEL.modelId,
   362→        }
   363→      });
   364→
   365→    } else {
   366→      const result = await generateText({
   367→        model: selectedModel,
   368→        messages: aiMessages,
   369→        maxOutputTokens: LOCKED_PARAMS.maxOutputTokens,
   370→        temperature: LOCKED_PARAMS.temperature,
   371→      });
   372→
   373→      return NextResponse.json({
   374→        success: true,
   375→        response: result.text,
   376→        model: LOCKED_MODEL.modelId,
   377→        isLocal: LOCKED_MODEL.isLocal,
   378→        usage: {
   379→          inputTokens: result.usage.inputTokens,
   380→          outputTokens: result.usage.outputTokens,
   381→          totalTokens: (result.usage.inputTokens || 0) + (result.usage.outputTokens || 0)
   382→        }
   383→      });
   384→    }
   385→
   386→  } catch (error) {
   387→    // =========================================================================
   388→    // ERROR HANDLING - Log and return graceful error
   389→    // =========================================================================
   390→    console.error('AI Chat error:', {
   391→      model: LOCKED_MODEL.modelId,
   392→      isLocal: LOCKED_MODEL.isLocal,
   393→      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
   394→    });
   395→
   396→    // For local Ollama errors, provide helpful message
   397→    if (LOCKED_MODEL.isLocal) {
   398→      return NextResponse.json({
   399→        error: 'Local AI service unavailable',
   400→        details: 'Ollama server may not be running. Start with: ollama serve',
   401→        model: LOCKED_MODEL.modelId,
   402→      }, { status: 503 });
   403→    }
   404→
   405→    return NextResponse.json({
   406→      error: 'AI service temporarily unavailable',
   407→      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
   408→      model: LOCKED_MODEL.modelId,
   409→    }, { status: 503 });
   410→  }
   411→}
   412→
   413→export async function OPTIONS() {
   414→  return new NextResponse(null, {
   415→    status: 200,
   416→    headers: {
   417→      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
   418→      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT',
   419→      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'X-CSRF-Token, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Version, Content-Length, Content-MD5, Content-Type, Date, X-Api-Version'
   420→    }
   421→  });
   422→}

``` **The core issue:** It directly uses `project.thumbnail` as the `src` attribute. If this is an empty string or invalid URL, the browser can't load the image and displays the alt text instead. --- ### 3. **lib/projects.ts - Thumbnail Population Status** Checking the projects array for thumbnail values: | Project | Thumbnail | Status | |---------|-----------|--------| | **general-reel** (line 77) | `https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/2081951507-d6a42cc...` | ✓ **HAS URL** | | **macmiller-hornet-balloonerism** (line 113) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **vision-pro-xr** (line 186) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **bell-canada-hyperspace** (line 222) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **play-with-oreo** (line 259) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **twizzlers-oz** (line 295) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **cinderella-film-reel** (line 331) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **lego-dimensions** (line 375) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **iphone-lighting** (line 439) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **northrop-grumman-hangar** (line 475) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | | **ice-breakers-watermelon-luge** (line 512) | `''` (empty string) | ✗ **EMPTY** | **Only 1 out of 11 projects has a thumbnail URL.** The other 10 have empty strings, which explains why you're seeing broken image icons showing alt text like "Apple Vision Pro" and "iPhone 14 Pro Max". --- ### 4. **app/api/ai-chat/route.ts - How Cards Get Injected** (lines 106-116) The system prompt explicitly instructs the AI to include project references: ``` PROJECT REFERENCES: - When mentioning specific projects, include [PROJECT:slug] markers for rich card rendering - Example: "Joseph's work on [PROJECT:cinderella-film-reel] showcases..." ``` **How it works:** - The LLM reads this instruction and inserts `[PROJECT:slug]` markers into responses - The frontend's `parseMessageWithProjects()` regex detects these markers: `/\[PROJECT:([a-z0-9-]+)\]/gi` (line 130) - For each match, it renders a `ChatProjectCard` component - That component calls `getProject(slug)` to fetch the project data (line 17) - The project data includes the empty thumbnail string - The `` tag tries to load an empty string as src → browser shows broken image + alt text --- ## Root Cause Summary **Why thumbnails show as broken images:** 1. **Empty thumbnail URLs in projects.ts** — 91% of projects (10 out of 11) have `thumbnail: ''` 2. **No fallback rendering** — `ChatProjectCard` doesn't check if thumbnail is empty before rendering the img tag 3. **Browser default behavior** — When src is empty, the browser displays the alt text instead of an image 4. **No error handling** — The component doesn't gracefully degrade if thumbnail is missing --- ## Recommended Fixes To fix broken thumbnails, you would need to (in order of impact): 1. **Populate thumbnail URLs** — Add Vimeo thumbnail URLs to all 10 empty-thumbnail projects (similar to the general-reel project) 2. **Add conditional rendering** — In `ChatProjectCard.tsx`, check if `project.thumbnail` exists before rendering the image; either hide the thumbnail div or show a placeholder 3. **Add error boundary** — Use `onError` handler on the `` tag to fallback to a placeholder if the image fails to load 4. **Cache Vimeo thumbnails** — Store thumbnails locally or via a CDN to avoid external dependency on Vimeo's image servers The screenshot you mentioned showing "Apple Vision Pro" and "iPhone 14 Pro Max" cards with broken image icons is displaying the alt text because those projects (vision-pro-xr and iphone-lighting) have empty thumbnail strings in lines 186 and 439 respectively.
